name: android_press_key
description: Presses a key or button: navigation (BACK, HOME, APP_SWITCH, ENTER, TAB), hardware (POWER, VOLUME_UP, VOLUME_DOWN, MUTE, CAMERA), screen power (WAKEUP, SLEEP), media (MEDIA_PLAY_PAUSE, MEDIA_NEXT, MEDIA_PREV), status bar panels (NOTIFICATIONS, QUICK_SETTINGS, CLOSE_PANELS), or game keys (DPAD_*, BUTTON_A/B/X/Y/L1/R1/START/SELECT, SPACE, ESCAPE).

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
